## Summary

Describe the problem and the chosen change.

## Evidence

Include tests, measurements, or reproduction output relevant to the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include generated caches or build products.
- [ ] `python -m ruff check .` passes.
- [ ] `python -m ruff format --check .` passes.
- [ ] Tests pass with coverage at or above the configured threshold.
- [ ] The quick experiment completes when experiment code changes.
- [ ] Public behavior and limitations are documented.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated for user-visible changes.
